description: This file defines the MessageOnlyLogFilter class which implements the LogNode interface. The class serves as a filter that forwards only log messages, stripping out additional metadata like tags or priority, useful for on-screen logs that prioritize simplicity.

classes.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
classes.description: A log node that filters messages, passing only the message content downstream.

methods.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
methods.description: Constructor that accepts the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Method that processes log messages; forwards only messages with null tag and default priority.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Retrieves the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode to which messages will be forwarded.
